integrity: The complete proof is in RESULT.md. Embedded standalone stdlib Python programs and captured output verify finite binary cases but do not substitute for the infinite proof. Originality is a qualified literature-based assessment. No independent external audit has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Only open ladders of rung length \(n=2^r-1\), \(r\ge2\), over finite fields of characteristic two are proved. Other lengths, characteristics, and graph-symmetry quotients remain untreated. A relevant older paper was accessible only at abstract level; historical priority is qualified.
title: Cyclotomic Jordan blocks and exact orbit populations for dyadic ladder waves
